description: Java entity class representing the join table between Email and Label, scoped by owner. It manages the association of labels to emails with attributes such as owner, email, label, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: EmailLabel
classes.description: Entity representing the many-to-many relationship between Email and Label, with additional context such as owner and creation timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the EmailLabel record.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the User who owns the email-label association.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the User who owns the email-label association.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email associated with this label.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email associated with this label.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the email.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label associated with the email.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when this association was created.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to initialize createdAt timestamp before persisting.

methods.name: EmailLabel (constructor)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new EmailLabel with specified owner, email, and label.
